title: Exterior Painting in Newberry, FL | Stucco & Siding
description: Exterior painting in Newberry, FL: wash, re-caulk, repair, and two coats of acrylic or elastomeric on stucco, siding, and trim. Up to 10-year warranty.
heroIntro: From fresh stucco subdivisions toward Town of Tioga to wood-sided homes near downtown, Newberry exteriors get a coating system chosen for the wall in front of us.

sections.h2: Signs your Newberry exterior is ready
body: Run a hand across a sunny wall. If it comes away chalky, the binder is breaking down. Other signals we see on Newberry homes:
bullets: Faded color on the west and south sides compared to the north
Open caulk joints around windows and trim on newer homes as framing settles
Green or black growth at the base of walls hit by sprinklers
Peeling or soft wood at fascia, sills, and door frames on older homes
Hairline cracks in stucco that are starting to widen

sections.h2: New stucco subdivisions vs. older wood homes
body: If your home is one of the newer builds in Newberry Oaks, Arbor Greens, or Country Way, the walls are most likely stucco or fiber-cement with painted trim. Stucco with hairline movement gets an elastomeric coating that stretches over small cracks; wider cracks are repaired first. Fiber-cement and trim get 100% acrylic. On these homes the prep is mostly washing, re-caulking, and spot-priming.

Restored homes near Downtown Newberry and the West End are a different job. Wood siding and trim need scraping to a tight edge, sanding, rot repair, and primer on bare wood. The schedule allows more prep days, and the estimate shows them.

sections.h2: How the exterior system goes on
body: Every exterior starts with a wash and mildew treatment. Next comes repair: nail pops reset, rotted wood and fascia replaced, moving joints cut out and re-sealed with flexible paintable sealant, and bare spots primed. Then two full coats of premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore, with a third for dramatic color changes or porous surfaces. Sprayed areas are back-rolled or back-brushed so the coating works into stucco texture and rough wood.

October through May is the best stretch for exterior painting in Newberry. In summer, crews start early, watch dew point, and track radar for afternoon storms. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time. Our article on how weather affects house painting in Florida explains why timing matters.

Exterior work carries a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, on top of the manufacturer's warranty. For stucco damage beyond hairlines, see stucco repair and painting. Many Newberry clients add a driveway and walkway wash or deck staining while the crew is there. Our Newberry location page covers the rest of what we do in town.

faqs.q: Can you match my HOA's approved exterior colors?
faqs.a: Yes. We match from a chip or existing surface and can provide full-size drawdowns for your approval request.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during exterior painting?
faqs.a: No. As long as we have access to water, outlets, and the yard, you can go about your day.

faqs.q: What happens if you find rotten wood?
faqs.a: Rot found at the walkthrough is itemized on the estimate. Anything discovered later is shown to you and only repaired with your written approval.
